alerts.title: Dynamic Multi-Tier Shell Company Layering Network
alerts.description: Detected corporate layering through 11 shell and trade entities with significant financial flow. Nominee/director relationships detected to obscure beneficial ownership.
entities_involved: Aura Gems & Bullion Exports Pvt Ltd
alerts.recommended_action: Issue Section 5 PMLA Provisional Attachment on intermediate shell accounts and summon nominee directors for Benami proceedings.

alerts.title: Behavioral Anomaly Detection: Structured Mule Network
alerts.description: Identified 3 sub-threshold transactions (< Rs 50,000) across 12 mule accounts with regular temporal pattern. Communication activity normal detected.
alerts.recommended_action: Freeze identified mule accounts under Sec 102 CrPC / Sec 17 PMLA; conduct temporal analysis of transaction patterns; investigate communication networks.

alerts.title: Emerging Modus Operandi Detection
alerts.description: Detected 1 unusual transaction types representing potential new money laundering techniques. High proportion of Asset_Acquisition transactions suggests evolving criminal methodology.
alerts.recommended_action: Conduct forensic analysis of transaction patterns; update threat intelligence feeds; consider temporary transaction monitoring increases.

alerts.title: Financial-Communication Activity Decoupling
